errata.orig:
potType OBJECT-TYPE
        SYNTAX     INTEGER {
           automatic-drip(1),
           percolator(2),
           french-press(3),
           espresso(4),
           }
        MAX-ACCESS read-write
        STATUS current
        DESCRIPTION
                "The brew type of the coffee pot."
        ::= { coffee 3 }
errata.correct:
potType OBJECT-TYPE
        SYNTAX     INTEGER {
           automatic-drip(1),
           percolator(2),
           french-press(3),
           espresso(4),
           }
        MAX-ACCESS read-only
        STATUS current
        DESCRIPTION
                "The brew type of the coffee pot."
        ::= { coffee 3 }
errata.notes: potName and potCapacity are read-only, as name and capacity will not change after instantiation; type should be as well, as potType will not change over time (reincarnation as a separate pot would constitute a new instance.) potLocation should remain read-write, as a pot may change locations.
